# S53 — Argument-parser failures bypass JSON error envelopes

**Findings:** S46 planning; slicer edit --json prints argparse usage only · **Size: S** · **Tree:** cli

## Why

`slicer edit --json` with missing required arguments exits 2 with argparse usage on stderr and no JSON on stdout. cli.main calls parse_args before its SlicerError handler. Agents cannot use the documented error envelope for parser failures.

## Files

src/slicer/cli.py; tests/test_errors.py; docs/agents.md.

## Failing tests

Missing required arguments, unknown options, invalid choices and conflicting parser options produce a usage envelope when --json is requested. Human errors and --help still work.

## Implement

Bring parser errors into the machine-readable usage contract, including nested commands. Preserve normal help and human-readable errors.

**Not in this slice:** changing command semantics or accepting invalid arguments.

## Check

Exercise real command invocations and assert exit status, stdout JSON, and stderr diagnostics.
